messages:
Ava Brooks: Quick request : building a one-page, customer-facing preflight for a renewal-risk account. Need it to be fillable by customer engs and include 3 runnable checks (cache hit, batch perf, streaming smoke). Keep it <1 page.

Samir Desai: Short form + three validation commands sounds right. Also include 'what to change now' with actionable defaults (cache_ttl, batch_size, enable_streaming).

Hannah Lee: Proposed thresholds: cache_hit < 30% = optimization candidate; p95 > 500ms = ops review; error_rate > 0.8% = escalate. Recommend streaming when avg latency > 300ms.

Ava Brooks: Add a tiny mapping of renewal signals -> immediate AM action:
- drop in MAU -> product usage review call
- rising latency or p95 regressions -> schedule ops deep-dive
- billing disputes -> finance escalation

ops_bot: Tip: use `/autofill <acct>` to pull last 7d cache_hit and p95 into the form.

Samir Desai: Pasteable email-friendly preflight template below (one-liners so AMs can paste):
---
ACCOUNT PREFLIGHT (please complete)
- Account name:
- Eng contact (name/email):
- Affected endpoint(s):
- Cache strategy (prefix/response/shared KV):
- Cache TTL(s) observed (s):
- Cache hit % (7d):
- batch_size (min/max):
- streaming enabled? (y/n):
- p95 latency (24h):
- error rate (24h):
- recent config changes (14d):
- priority flows (1-3):
---

Calvin Park: Quick runnable checks for customers to paste: 
1) streaming smoke test:
```
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Prefer: streaming=1" -d '{"input":"hi","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```
2) simple p95 loop (bash):
```
for i in {1..15}; do time curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate; done
```
3) cache header check:
```
curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate | grep -i cache
```

Hannah Lee: Quick recommended changes checklist to include (checkboxes):
- Increase cache_ttl to 1800-3600s for stable prompts
- Switch repetitive prompts to prefix caching
- Reduce batch_size to 1-4 for UI-interactive flows
- Enable streaming for generations where avg >300ms
- Enable warm-pools/autoscale burst for high short-term load

Ava Brooks: Perfect. Samir, can you assemble a one-pager PDF + plain-text email snippet by EOD? Tag me when ready and I'll route to AMs.

Samir Desai: Yep, will post draft here in ~3 hours and attach sample graphs (cache hit over time + p95).

ops_bot: Created ticket CS-PREFLIGHT-9901 assigned to Samir Desai.

Calvin Park: I'll drop node/python smoke-test examples into repo once draft is up.

Ava Brooks: Thanks team . This will save us time on renewal outreach and give AMs concrete ask items for engs.
